decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The erection of two-storey rear extension to the existing dwellinghouse, as shown on drawing numbers 489/100/1/ Rev A and 489/100/2PA/Rev B, received 13 July 2006, would not harm the appearance of the existing building and street scene or the amenity of neighbouring properties and would preserve and enhance the appearance and character of Strand on the Green Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development is consistent with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas, and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a two storey rear extension to house.
